neighbours.label: the definite article in a nonstandard spelling: dialect, text-speak or OCR forms of 'the' (de, d, da, tho), and the Arabic article in vocalised text
fire: Den he pick up de bucket an' carry it down to de well.
wen ur done wit d charger plz put it bak on d shelf

Every window in tho house was
broken and tho roof had fallen in.
Sho' nuff, he run all de way back to de cabin that night.
my sis broke d screen on her tablet n now d touch dont work

notes: Standard ' the' stayed at 0.11 in probing while the same frame with ' de' passed 1.2. The test keeps the dialect register in the near misses and drops only the article.
